title: Red-first proof is on by default in every non-vacuous adopted repository
body:
Why: Fable 1115g slice 1; the test-first Stop arm (src/hook/stop.ts:621-624) runs only under KRN_TEST_FIRST, so lanes can ship fixes without a test or with a test that passes without the fix.
Outcome: the test-first arm is on by default where the repo has a test command; the Stop refusal names the missing red-at-base proof; KRN_TEST_FIRST=0 opts out.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-brief.ts, src/repo/agents-render.ts, tests.
Proof: a Stop test is red without a red-at-base test and green with one; three outside rows drain 0 with at least 1 red-at-base test each.
